description: This file defines the DUEL templating engine, including type definitions, view binding, rendering to HTML and DOM, and utility functions. It includes internal classes and methods for processing templates, handling errors, and outputting results.

classes.name: Markup
classes.description: Wraps a string value to maintain as raw markup in output, with a toString method for rendering.

classes.name: Result
classes.description: Represents the result of a template binding, capable of rendering to HTML or DOM, and managing callbacks.

classes.name: Buffer
classes.description: String buffer utility for efficient string concatenation and rendering.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Determines the type of a value, returning a numeric code.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends a child node or attribute to a parent node in the template structure.

methods.name: bindContent
methods.description: Binds a template node to data, producing a fragment or value.

methods.name: loop
methods.description: Processes a loop template, iterating over data collections.

methods.name: xor
methods.description: Processes conditional template blocks, selecting the first true condition.

methods.name: call
methods.description: Invokes a nested view/template with data context.

methods.name: part
methods.description: Replaces a placeholder part with a named partial view.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Main function that binds a template node to data, dispatching based on node type.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders a view tree into an HTML string.

methods.name: toDOM
methods.description: Converts a view tree into DOM nodes, optionally replacing an existing element.

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Replaces the entire document with the current view.
